description: Package Windows Codex Desktop compatibility fixes for Computer Use, Browser, and durable /goal workflows.

features.description: Create durable project and goal harness files.
steps: Create goal.md with objective, constraints, and verification criteria.
Create feature_list.json and progress logs.
Create init.ps1 for quick context recovery.
features.verification: tests/run-tests.ps1 confirms required harness files exist and parse.

features.description: Add safe Windows PowerShell tooling for export, validation, and release packaging.
steps: Add project validator with required-file and secret checks.
Add local Codex asset exporter with redaction.
Add dry-run installer and release packager scripts.

features.description: Document Computer Use, Browser, /goal, security, and release workflows.
steps: Write Browser runtime guide for bundled Browser, Chrome/CDP, and agent-browser fallback.
Write Computer Use Windows guide.
Write Goal Mode fallback and release checklist.
features.verification: README links and docs paths are present; validator exits 0.

features.description: Create README visual asset and wire it into the project.
steps: Compile a GPT-Image2/GPTGod prompt using the infographic template family.
Generate or fallback-create a README hero image.
Verify README image path resolves.
features.verification: tests/run-tests.ps1 confirms README image references exist.

features.description: Rewrite README in Chinese and add an English companion README with richer evidence and visuals.
steps: Extract the WeChat article content now available from the opened browser URL.
Create docs/research/wechat-qoder-computer-use.md with source summary and project implications.
Rewrite README using Chinese headings and prose, preserving product names as proper nouns only.
Add an English README companion with mirrored structure.
Show the latest screenshots from images/.
features.verification: validate-project.ps1 confirms bilingual README layout, local screenshots, and required research notes.

features.description: Generate and wire multiple README architecture images through GPTGod.
steps: Delegate GPTGod generation to a sub-agent and wait for remote completion.
Add at least two architecture/principle images to assets/readme.
Reference at least three local images from README.
Keep the latest hero image and architecture diagrams in the repo.
features.verification: validate-project.ps1 requires at least three README image references and checks they exist.

features.description: Run self-review and prepare repository for GitHub upload.
steps: Run validation and package release.
Run a review pass for language consistency, image links, and secret leakage.
Report Git status and next publish command.
features.verification: tests/run-tests.ps1 and package-release.ps1 exit 0; git status shows only intended tracked files.
